newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ENDEMOL SHARES START TRADING AT DFL 55.80.
newsitem.headline: ENDEMOL SHARES START TRADING AT DFL 55.80.

text.p: Shares in bourse newcomer Endemol started trading at 55.80 guilders per share in early afternoon on Friday.
On Thursday ABN AMRO, global coordinator of the public offering of Endemol, said the stock was priced at 48.00 guilders per share. The issue was 25 times over-subscribed, it said.
Dealers said the price of the stock was still relatively cheap. "Endemol could rise 10 to 15 percent within one year," said one dealer.
"Endemol should be in the portfolio of all institutional investors," said one dealer, adding private investors also had a great appetite for the stock.
Endemol was priced at around 52.00-54.00 guilders on the grey market, few hours before official trade started on Friday.
Traders had set an advisory price of 55.00 guilders per share on the screen before official trade took off.
In less than a quarter of an hour of trade shares in Dutch television production firm Endemol Entertainment were trading at 56.70 guilders per share in high volume.
